selection.broadPhase: Intersect each object bounds translated by current homeOffset; nearest box is only a candidate.
selection.narrowPhase: Raycast the raw assembled parts in the nearest candidate objects, with proxyRoot translated by homeOffset and matrixWorld updated. Use recursive raycast: multi-primitive meshes may retain intermediate Groups. Find nearest ancestor part_id and match workstation_<object>_ prefix.
selection.rendering: Keep raw proxyRoot outside the rendered scene; Mesh.raycast works without scene membership. Use cached original root for proxy. Detail root clones ONLY the chosen matching parts, preserving part_id, mesh_id, material names and original bedroom appearanceByMesh/sketchByMaterial. Do not mutate linked_source or rename mesh IDs.
selection.explode: Keyboard: group all workstation_keyboard_key_* at one offset above switch_plate; move upper_case, switch_plate, lower_case in a vertical stack. Other objects have 1–17 authored parts and can decompose directly.
